conditions: The default one-swipe exit behavior causes unexpected exits.

title: Retain default full-screen exit gestures

statement.en: Whenever possible, retain the familiar default full-screen exit gesture behavior in iOS and iPadOS.
statement.ja: 可能な限りiOSとiPadOSの馴染みあるdefault full-screen exit gesture behaviorを維持する。

conditions: The Home Screen indicator reappears near the bottom and permits a one-swipe exit.
exceptions: Consider gesture deferral only when the default produces unexpected exits.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Going full screen experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
